mapper.insert: insert into platform_role_permission (id, role_id, permission_id, created_at) values (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select permission_id from platform_role_permission where role_id = #{roleId}
select p.`code` from platform_role_permission rp inner join platform_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId}
select role_id from platform_role_permission where permission_id = #{permissionId}
